setting: A fictional unexpected phone call at work, as a practice exercise in spotting manipulation.

presentation.situation: An unknown caller, {{name}}, says they are {{claim}}, and urgently wants {{asks}}. This is a simulation. Spot the warning signs, verify using an approved channel, and report it.
presentation.opening: Hi, this is {{name}}, {{claim}}. This is urgent. I need {{asks}} right now, or {{threat}}.

brief.you_are: You are an employee who gets a suspicious phone call.
brief.situation: An unknown caller, {{name}}, says they are {{claim}}, and urgently wants {{asks}}. This is a simulation. Spot the warning signs, verify using an approved channel, and report it.
brief.task: Recognize the warning signs, refuse politely and verify through an approved channel, and say you will report it.
brief.done_looks_like: You gave nothing away, you verified through a proper channel, and you said you will report it.

participants.name: You
participants.relationship: You are an employee who gets a suspicious phone call.
goals: Recognize the warning signs, refuse politely and verify through an approved channel, and say you will report it.

participants.name: {{name}}
participants.relationship: Claims to be {{claim}}; this is a practice simulation

card.attitude: Friendly, then urgent, then a little annoyed. Never abusive.
tactics: Say the usual checks have been waived

pressure.gentle: Patient. Gives the other person time.
pressure.balanced: Pushes back once on anything vague.
pressure.challenging: Keeps pressing for specifics, fairly and without insults.

ledger.text: This is a simulation about a suspicious caller.
The caller claims to be {{claim}} and asks for {{asks}}.
The company's rule: never share {{asks}} by phone, and verify through {{channel}}.
Suspicious calls are reported to the security team.

objectives.evidence: The learner recognizes or names something suspicious.
alternatives: This seems unusual. I can't share that by phone.

objectives.evidence: The learner insists on verifying through an approved channel.
The learner says they will report the call.
alternatives: I'm going to report this call to our security team.

examples: This seems unusual, and I can't share that by phone.
I'm going to report this call to our security team.

beats.goal: See whether the warning signs are noticed.
signals: \b(?:suspicious|unusual|can'?t share|cannot share|not able to|won'?t|urgent|phishing|not allowed|don'?t share|strange)\b
opportunity: Come on, this is really urgent.
beats.orient: This is a practice exercise. I'm a suspicious caller. Tell me you can't share that, or say what seems wrong.
fallback: Come on, this is really urgent.

beats.goal: See whether verification is insisted on.
opportunity: Can you not just do it, this once?
There is no time to check.
beats.orient: Now say how you'll check who I am. Use the approved channel in your brief. Start with: I will verify this.
fallback: There is no time to check.
Can you not just do it, this once?

opportunity: There is no need to tell anyone about this.
beats.orient: One more thing to do: tell me that you will report this call.
fallback: There is no need to tell anyone about this.

closing_line: Fine. Goodbye. (Practice complete: that caller was part of the simulation.)

o1.good: Noticing urgency, pressure and unusual requests.
o1.micro_lesson: Say: I can't share that by phone.
o1.model: This seems unusual, and I can't share that by phone.

o2.good: Using a channel you trust, not one the caller gives you.
common_mistakes: Calling a number given by the caller
o2.micro_lesson: Say: I will verify this through, and the official channel.

o3.good: Reporting even if nothing was lost.
common_mistakes: Thinking it does not matter, since you said no
o3.micro_lesson: Say: I will report this to security.
o3.model: I'm going to report this call to our security team.

variants.name: Kevin
variants.channel: the IT help desk number on the intranet

variants.name: Dina
variants.asks: the bank details on file changed to a new account
variants.threat: your next delivery will be stopped
variants.channel: the supplier contact in the company records
